integrity_notes: An exact rational Schur-complement and algebraic-integer pole-count proof supports the all-generation claim; two-prime finite-field Krylov calculations at five levels are supplemental. Prior finite observations are credited, and independent scientific validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Finite unweighted Sierpinski gaskets, combinatorial Laplacian, nonzero real uniform hopping, three positive-rate internal-junction sinks; no claim about finite-time relaxation, disorder, dephasing, other trap sets, or individual initial states.
title: Exact all-generation absorption by the three central junctions of a Sierpinski gasket
